criteria.requirement: Failing service, production environment, deployment identity, commit, author, and duration are quickly scannable.
Succeeded, failed, and not-started stages are distinguishable without relying on color alone.
The migration failure and its first useful error appear before the full log and retain exact supplied facts.
Full log content is available on demand, readable, and does not overwhelm the primary diagnosis.
The exact error and commit SHA can each be copied with specific success or failure feedback.
Retry communicates what will rerun and requires an intentional confirmation before execution.
Rollback is distinct from retry and communicates the production consequence before execution.
Busy, cancellation, completion, and error states prevent ambiguous or duplicate deployment actions.
Diagnosis order, logs, and action controls remain usable without page overflow at both required viewports.
Landmarks, headings, focus indicators, keyboard order, status messaging, and touch targets are usable and inspectable.
